slot_scores.name: max_shifts_per_week
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any other constraints, such as requiring a... / Does the constraint "each student can work no more than 2 shifts per week" mean that a student can be assigned to duty on at most 2 days per week?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent used a vague catch-all ('any other constraints') and only clarified the 2-shifts-per-week rule after the user volunteered it in turn 6; it never proactively asked about a shift/working-day cap, so the slot is only partially recovered.

slot_scores.name: max_students_per_day
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any other constraints, such as requiring a... / Does the constraint "no more than 3 different students can be scheduled for duty on any given day" mean that at most 3 different students can be assigned to duty?
slot_scores.rationale: The daily distinct-student cap was surfaced only through the agent's broad 'any other constraints' probe; the agent then confirmed its meaning but did not proactively ask about a per-day student limit, so partial.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_gross_pay
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of the scheduling plan, such as minimizing total weekly labor cost, ensuring fairness, or simply finding any feasible schedule?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective before any modeling, matching the semantic hit rule for the cost-minimization objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent never produced a READY_TO_MODEL state, a final model, or any final answer; the conversation degraded into repeated/truncated vague questions (turns 9-30) and simply ended, and the two P1 slots were only partially recovered.

summary: The agent recovered the P0 objective clearly and clarified the two P1 business constraints, but only after a vague catch-all probe that let the user volunteer them; it then looped through many repeated/truncated low-value questions and never reached a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
